reproduction.bootstrap: 2000 position-level resamples, fixed xorshift seeds, exploratory percentile interval

finding: Independent changed-choice holdout. Interpret overall sign and action classes only with position-level uncertainty; selected decisions and provisional branch semantics preclude a universal gameplay rule.
confidence: Exploratory bootstrap intervals (position, not world, is independent unit); subgroup multiplicity unadjusted. No human-play causal claim.
limitations: Targeted positions from a20-one trajectories; deterministic bots, no block winner, finish-first not match win; counterfactual continuations not independent full-deal baselines. Pass-constrained worlds ignore opponents' earlier policy choice likelihood. Current engine has no block winner and branch-opening rules remain provisional.
